findings.fact: The branch checks the final common.run process receipt child_cpu_seconds in [0,90), but does not check that receipt's elapsed_ns in [0,180000000000).
reasoning: The group script measures its own elapsed after source-after checks and source-pins writing, then writes summary.json and prints its final stdout. The accounting wrapper writes its own final JSON later still.
common.run waits with timeout=180 and measures elapsed_ns after child exit and complete stdout/stderr file reads. That later complete receipt is available to panel().

A child that exits within the wait timeout may still have a common receipt elapsed_ns at or above the strict wall threshold after the final collection/readback tail. Neither the earlier child summary nor wait(timeout=180) imposes the missing completed-receipt comparison.
This is a static allowed-path finding, not an executed timing counterexample or a claim that a particular case exceeded its limit.
findings.minimum_fix: Inside the same label.startswith('worker-late-Core-group-') branch require a numeric final process elapsed_ns with 0 <= elapsed_ns < 180000000000; retain CPU, source, case, group, compiler and all existing assertions.

The CI finally verifies submitted/oracle/restored/source paths independently before common.finish. Failure records retain original summaries/process receipts. Raw archival work is not silently reclassified as execution of a runtime group.
